function.name: checklist_write
function.description: Replace the active thread/task checklist. Use this for granular progress under the current durable task or runtime thread; durable tasks remain the real executable work object.

todos.description: The complete list of todo items. This replaces the existing list.

function.name: diagnostics
function.description: Report workspace info, git detection, sandbox availability, and Rust toolchain versions.

function.name: file_search
function.description: Find files by name using fuzzy matching with score-based ranking. Use this instead of `find -name` or `fd` in `exec_shell` for filename search. Pass `extensions` to filter by suffix.

query.description: Search query (file name or path fragment).

path.description: Optional base path to search (relative to workspace).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20).

extensions.description: Optional list of file extensions to include (e.g. ["rs", "md"]).

exclude.description: Optional glob patterns to exclude, matching grep_files' convention (e.g. ["target/**", "*.lock"]).

function.name: github_issue_context
function.description: Read GitHub issue context using gh. Read-only: body/comments/labels/state are summarized and large bodies become task artifacts when a durable task is active.

function.name: github_pr_context
function.description: Read GitHub PR context using gh: body/comments/reviews/check status/files and optional diff artifact. Read-only; no push/merge/close.

function.name: grep_files
function.description: Search for a regex pattern in workspace files. Use this instead of `grep -r`, `rg`, or `find ... -exec grep` in `exec_shell` — pure-Rust, faster, and respects `.gitignore`. Returns matching lines with context (default: 2 lines before/after each match).

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern to search for

path.description: Directory or file to search (relative to workspace, default: .)

include.description: Glob patterns for files to include (e.g., ['*.rs', '*.ts'])

exclude.description: Glob patterns for files to exclude (e.g., ['*.min.js', 'node_modules/*'])

context_lines.description: Number of context lines before and after each match (default: 2)

case_insensitive.description: Whether to perform case-insensitive matching (default: false)

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 100)

function.name: handle_read
function.description: Read a bounded projection from a var_handle returned by tools such as RLM sessions, sub-agents, or large artifact producers. Provide exactly one projection: `slice` for char/line slices, `range` for one-based line ranges, `count` for metadata counts, or `jsonpath` for a small JSON-path projection. This retrieves from the handle's backing environment instead of asking the parent transcript to hold the full payload.

handle.description: A var_handle object, or a compact `session_id/name` string.

slice.description: Zero-based half-open slice over chars or lines.

count.description: Return counts for the handle payload.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters to return in this projection. Defaults to 12000; hard-capped at 50000.

function.name: list_dir
function.description: List entries in a directory relative to the workspace. Use this instead of `ls`, `ls -la`, or `find . -maxdepth 1` in `exec_shell` for directory listings.

function.name: notify
function.description: Fire a single desktop notification (OSC 9 / terminal bell). Use sparingly — only when a long-running task completes, when a turn was waiting on a remote operation that just finished, or when the user genuinely needs to come back to the terminal. Pass a short `title` and an optional `body`. Do NOT use this for routine progress updates, conversational acknowledgements, or confirmation that the model is alive — that's noise. The user can disable notifications entirely via `[notifications].method = "off"` in `~/.deepseek/config.toml`; when disabled this tool is a silent no-op.

title.description: Short notification title (≤ 80 chars after truncation). Required.

body.description: Optional longer body (≤ 200 chars after truncation).

function.name: read_file
function.description:
Read a UTF-8 file from the workspace. Use this instead of `cat`, `head`, `tail`, or `sed -n '..p'` in `exec_shell` — it's faster, sandbox-aware, and skips the approval prompt. Plain text is returned as-is; PDFs are auto-extracted via the bundled pure-Rust extractor (no Poppler install required). Cannot read images or non-PDF binaries.

For large files, use `start_line` and `max_lines` to read in chunks. By default, returns at most 200 lines (~16KB). If `truncated="true"` in the response, use `next_start_line` to continue reading. For PDFs, use `pages` instead — `start_line`/`max_lines` only apply to text files.

path.description: Path to the file (relative to workspace or absolute)

pages.description: PDF only: page range to extract, e.g. "1-5" or "10". Ignored for non-PDF files.

function.name: recall_archive
function.description: Search prior context cycles for content not in your briefing. Use sparingly — frequent recalls mean your briefing was too sparse; refine your next briefing.

query.description: Search query. Tokenized and BM25-scored against archived messages.

cycle.description: Optional: limit to a specific prior cycle number.

max_results.description: Maximum hits to return (default 3, hard-capped at 10).

function.name: request_user_input
function.description: Ask the user 1-3 short questions and return their selections.

function.name: rlm_close
function.description: Close a named RLM context, tear down its Python kernel, and return usage/lifecycle metadata.

function.name: rlm_configure
function.description: Configure a named RLM context: output feedback, child query timeout, recursive sub-RLM depth, and explicit session sharing.

function.name: rlm_eval
function.description: Run one Python REPL block against a named RLM context. Returns a bounded projection of stdout/stderr plus metadata. If the code calls FINAL/finalize, the final value is stored as a var_handle retrievable with handle_read instead of copied unbounded into the parent context. Batch child helpers require dependency_mode='independent'; use sub_query_sequence or a sequential loop for dependent work.

code.description: Python code to execute. Do not include markdown fences.

function.name: rlm_open
function.description: Open a persistent RLM context. Loads `file_path`, `content`, or `url` into a named Python kernel and returns only metadata: name, length, preview, and sha256. Use this for large or unfamiliar inputs so the parent transcript holds a handle, not the body.

name.description: Caller-chosen context name, unique within this parent session. Defaults to a slug from the source.

content.description: Inline content to load. Capped at 200k chars.

url.description: HTTP/HTTPS URL to fetch through fetch_url and load.

function.name: task_create
function.description: Create/enqueue a durable background task through TaskManager. Durable tasks are restart-aware executable work, distinct from sub-agents.

prompt.description: Work prompt for the durable task.

workspace.description: Workspace path; defaults to current workspace.

function.name: task_gate_run
function.description: Run an approved verification gate command and return structured evidence. When inside a durable task, the gate result and log artifact are attached to that task.

cwd.description: Optional working directory within the workspace.

function.name: task_list
function.description: List recent durable tasks with status, linked thread/turn ids, and concise summaries.

function.name: task_read
function.description: Read durable task detail including timeline, checklist, gate evidence, artifacts, and PR attempts.

task_id.description: Full task id or unambiguous prefix.

function.name: task_shell_start
function.description: Start a long-running shell command in the background and return a shell task_id immediately. Use task_shell_wait to poll and optionally record gate evidence on the active durable task.

cwd.description: Optional working directory within the workspace.

function.name: task_shell_wait
function.description: Poll a background shell task without blocking the agent indefinitely. If `gate` is supplied and the shell task has completed, records structured gate evidence on the active durable task.

task_id.description: Background shell task id returned by task_shell_start or exec_shell.

command.description: Original command, used when recording gate evidence.

function.name: todo_write
function.description: Compatibility alias for checklist_write. Replace the active thread/task checklist; durable tasks are the real executable work object.

todos.description: The complete list of todo items. This replaces the existing list.

function.name: update_plan
function.description: Update the implementation plan with steps and their status. Use this to track progress on implementation tasks. Each step has a description and status (pending, in_progress, completed). Optionally include an explanation of the overall approach.

explanation.description: Optional high-level explanation of the plan or approach

function.name: js_execution
function.description: Execute JavaScript code in a local sandboxed Node.js runtime and return stdout/stderr/return_code as JSON.

function.name: tool_search_tool_regex
function.description: Search deferred tool definitions using a regex query and return matching tool references.

query.description: Regex pattern to search tool names/descriptions/schema.

function.name: tool_search_tool_bm25
function.description: Search deferred tool definitions using natural-language matching and return matching tool references.

query.description: Natural language query for tool discovery.
